x, y, n = map(int, input().split())
min_difference = 1e18
numerator = 0
denominator = 1

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    a = (x * i) // y
    current_diff = abs((x / y) - (a / i))
    if current_diff < min_difference:
        min_difference = current_diff
        numerator = a
        denominator = i
    a += 1
    current_diff = abs((x / y) - (a / i))
    if current_diff < min_difference:
        min_difference = current_diff
        numerator = a
        denominator = i

print(f"{numerator}/{denominator}")
